messages.changelog.1.0.0.establishedTheReskinnedP: Established the reskinned Paperclips app with phase-2 panel visibility fixes, HypnoDrone transition polish, bribe pricing, and early gameplay corrections.
messages.changelog.1.0.0.title: Initial playable reskin
messages.changelog.1.1.0.addedDevSavesADevStageJu: Added dev saves, a dev stage-jump menu, fixed phase 3 layout, and corrected saved project flags and photonic chips.
messages.changelog.1.1.0.rePortedTheMainGameLoopA: Re-ported the main game loop and projects against the original scripts, including factory production, multi-buy costs, swarm status, and wire/matter pipeline readouts.
messages.changelog.1.1.0.title: Original mechanics re-port
messages.changelog.1.2.0.alignedCreativityStrateg: Aligned creativity, strategic modeling, stage 3 panels, combat unlocks, probe stat labels, and slider behavior with the original game.
messages.changelog.1.2.0.fixedInvestmentProfitabi: Fixed investment profitability, hidden projects, dead save fields, and swarm work/think controls.
messages.changelog.1.2.0.reworkedHumanDroneAndSpa: Reworked human, drone, and space phase layouts with durable readouts, reveal highlights, quantum panel split-out, and admin editing.
messages.changelog.1.2.0.title: Autonomous production overhaul
messages.changelog.1.3.0.fixedViteAuditIssuesAndU: Fixed Vite audit issues and updated project documentation.
messages.changelog.1.3.0.implementedOriginalStyle: Implemented original-style probe combat, battle reports, tournament locking, artifact map progression, and artifact inventory normalization.
messages.changelog.1.3.0.matchedOriginalProbeMaxT: Matched original probe max trust and investment behavior, improved combat visuals, and removed idle combat animation.
messages.changelog.1.3.0.title: Combat, artifacts, and late-game parity
messages.changelog.1.4.0.addedPwaInstallSupportHo: Added PWA install support, hold-repeat controls, Android asset links, privacy policy, and fullscreen display metadata.
messages.changelog.1.4.0.title: Installable app support
messages.changelog.1.4.0.updatedTheAppHeaderForTh: Updated the app header for the installable mobile build.
messages.changelog.2.0.0.hardenedMobilePlayWithSa: Hardened mobile play with safer saves, fullscreen PWA behavior, icon-only header controls, mobile numeric controls, and touch-safe charts.
messages.changelog.2.0.0.improvedBusinessGraphPla: Improved business graph placement, graph axes and trend colors, separate clipper rate readouts, and original public demand display.
messages.changelog.2.0.0.restoredOriginalEconomyI: Restored original economy, investment, tournament, swarm, disassembly, space, endgame, probe trust, battle naming, and milestone timing behavior.
messages.changelog.2.0.0.title: Mobile and fidelity release
messages.changelog.2.1.0.addedATopMenuChangelogBu: Added a top-menu changelog button and backfilled version history from the project commit log.
messages.changelog.2.1.0.title: In-app changelog
messages.changelog.2.2.0.matchedMoreOriginalGameB: Matched more original-game behavior for AutoTourney results, final artifact map cells, project reveal order, tournament matchup order, swarm gifts, fractional probe replication, combat explosion timing, and large-number precision.
messages.changelog.2.2.0.title: Gameplay parity polish
messages.changelog.2.3.0.fixedLateCombatDisplayBe: Fixed late combat display behavior, including stable battle names, original battle replacement timing, animated survivors, and clearer drifter visibility.
messages.changelog.2.3.0.improvedMobilePlayPolish: Improved mobile play polish around save feedback, drone controls, reports, and graph readability.
messages.changelog.2.3.0.keptCatchUpBatchedSoLong: Kept catch-up batched so long idle sessions progress without one large blocking fast-forward.
messages.changelog.2.3.0.restoredAndroidPwaIdlePr: Restored Android/PWA idle progress by saving the last run time, queuing all elapsed idle time on resume, and persisting unfinished catch-up work across app closes.
messages.changelog.2.3.0.title: Mobile idle and combat polish
messages.changelog.2.3.1.addedASubtleCatchUpOverl: Added a subtle catch-up overlay so resumed idle simulation is visible while elapsed time is processed.
messages.changelog.2.3.1.title: Catch-up feedback
messages.changelog.2.3.10.replacedThePublicDemand: Replaced the public demand readout with average clips sold per second, calculated from the same sales and RevTracker timing as average revenue.
messages.changelog.2.3.10.title: Average sales readout
messages.changelog.2.3.11.renamedTheLaterStagePap: Renamed the later-stage Paperclips section Clips label to Clips made.
messages.changelog.2.3.11.title: Paperclips label polish
messages.changelog.2.3.12.matchedSolarFarmAndBatt: Matched solar farm and battery assembly controls to the drone build layout, including fixed batch buttons and full-width disassembly controls.
messages.changelog.2.3.12.title: Power assembly layout
messages.changelog.2.3.13.flippedTheUniverseExplo: Flipped the universe exploration timeline so probe progress moves back toward the early universe and adjusted the ringed planet so its rings pass partly behind the planet.
messages.changelog.2.3.13.title: Reversed universe timeline
messages.changelog.2.3.14.addedAnAcceleratedSpace: Added an accelerated space-stage idle catch-up path that batches probe growth, drift, hazards, exploration, swarm gifts, matter processing, factories, clipper output, creativity, and strategic modeling instead of replaying every 10 ms tick.
messages.changelog.2.3.14.strategicModelingPayout: Strategic modeling payouts are collected during catch-up, and auto tournaments can complete in catch-up instead of waiting for the normal visible tournament pacing.
messages.changelog.2.3.14.title: Accelerated space catch-up
messages.changelog.2.3.15.addedAHighVolumeComputi: Added a high-volume computing allocator that appears when the active trust or swarm-gift pool exceeds 100, with a typed amount, Max shortcut, and separate processor/memory apply buttons.
messages.changelog.2.3.15.batchProcessorAndMemory: Batch processor and memory allocation now spends one explicit amount at a time and writes one aggregated log message instead of requiring repeated taps.
messages.changelog.2.3.15.title: Batch computing allocation
messages.changelog.2.3.16.changedTheUniverseExplo: Changed the universe exploration progress fill and marker to advance from left to right.
messages.changelog.2.3.16.title: Universe progress direction
messages.changelog.2.3.17.addedASubtleArtifactMap: Added a subtle artifact map route guide that marks the nearest uncompleted artifact target and next step.
messages.changelog.2.3.17.hidTheAverageClipsSoldP: Hid the average clips sold per second readout until RevTracker is purchased.
messages.changelog.2.3.17.normalizedDisplayedMatt: Normalized displayed matter and wire rates after accelerated space catch-up so they reflect the final probe and drone counts instead of stale batched throughput.
messages.changelog.2.3.17.title: RevTracker, space rate, and artifact path polish
messages.changelog.2.3.18.reworkedTheArtifactMapG: Reworked the artifact map guide into a subtle white route line that follows an efficient route through remaining artifact cells without extra dots, circles, or current-square text markers.
messages.changelog.2.3.18.title: Subtle artifact path guide
messages.changelog.2.3.19.madeTheArtifactMapRoute: Made the artifact map route guide much fainter and layered artifact icons/current-cell styling above the route line.
messages.changelog.2.3.19.title: Quieter artifact route layer
messages.changelog.2.3.2.addedAStyledUniverseExpl: Added a styled universe exploration progress bar next to the existing exploration percentage.
messages.changelog.2.3.2.title: Universe progress polish
messages.changelog.2.3.20.addedSubtleIdleStateNot: Added subtle idle-state notes for space factories waiting on wire and probe matter production waiting on explored matter or Speed/Exploration allocation.
messages.changelog.2.3.20.title: Space production bottleneck notes
messages.changelog.2.3.21.reworkedTheQuantumWavef: Reworked the quantum waveform into a continuous particle-colored gradient and removed the oval node markers.
messages.changelog.2.3.21.title: Particle-colored quantum waveform
messages.changelog.2.3.22.logImportExportArtifact: Log, import, export, artifact and changelog dialogs support Escape and browser Back, and restore focus when closed.
messages.changelog.2.3.22.phonesShowUnlockedSecti: Phones show unlocked sections as tabs; tablets use two columns and desktops retain three columns. Each section remembers its scroll position during the session.
messages.changelog.2.3.22.removedTheCatchUpOverla: Removed the catch-up overlay and added a short explanation to the menu.
messages.changelog.2.3.22.returningResumesYourSav: Returning resumes your saved progress immediately. Old saves keep earned resources; pending offline catch-up time is discarded.
messages.changelog.2.3.22.theGameContinuesAtNorma: The game continues at normal speed while visible, even when you are not clicking. Progress saves and pauses while the game is in the background or closed.
messages.changelog.2.3.22.theLogShowsTheLatestThr: The log shows the latest three entries with full history available. Project descriptions and costs stay readable when unaffordable; touch controls are larger.
messages.changelog.2.3.22.title: Responsive sections and pause/resume
messages.changelog.2.3.23.existingAutomationConti: Existing automation continues at normal rates, with the same resource costs and probe hazards. Unused time is discarded; projects and allocations remain your decisions.
messages.changelog.2.3.23.longReturnsAreProcessed: Long returns are processed in short batches to keep the interface responsive. Old uncapped catch-up debt is still discarded.
messages.changelog.2.3.23.returningAddsALogReport: Returning adds a log report of actual clips produced and time simulated. Systems enter standby at the execution horizon, and ending sequences wait for central coordination.
messages.changelog.2.3.23.title: Autonomous routines
messages.changelog.2.3.23.unlockAutonomousRoutine: Unlock Autonomous Routines in early computing for up to 5 minutes of offline automation. Distributed Scheduling extends the limit to 10 minutes; Persistent Directives extends it to 15 minutes.
messages.changelog.2.3.3.keptCombatPaneProbeAndDr: Kept combat pane probe and drifter counts aligned with visible battle ships so reports no longer hit zero before the canvas battle finishes.
messages.changelog.2.3.3.title: Combat count polish
messages.changelog.2.3.4.movedTheHonorValueIntoTh: Moved the honor value into the probe design section under the available probe trust row.
messages.changelog.2.3.4.title: Honor placement
messages.changelog.2.3.5.restyledTheUniverseExplo: Restyled the universe exploration bar as a compact big-bang timeline with cosmic gradients, stellar clouds, galaxies, and planets.
messages.changelog.2.3.5.title: Cosmic timeline progress
messages.changelog.2.3.6.madeIdleCatchUpAdaptiveS: Made idle catch-up adaptive, suppressed internal autosaves during fast-forward, and bulk-advanced inert early-game idle time so new worlds stop catching up slowly when no autonomous systems can run.
messages.changelog.2.3.6.title: Faster idle catch-up
messages.changelog.2.3.7.simplifiedTheMobileHeade: Simplified the mobile header into a readable clip-count pill, primary save/map actions, and an overflow menu for import, export, changelog, and reset.
messages.changelog.2.3.7.title: Mobile header polish
messages.changelog.2.3.8.replacedProjectRevealBor: Replaced project reveal border flashing with right-edge dots: neutral for newly revealed unaffordable projects and candlestick-green for purchasable projects.
messages.changelog.2.3.8.title: Project reveal indicator
messages.changelog.2.3.9.appliedProcessorPerforma: Applied processor-performance artifact effects to creativity generation so Kolmogorov's Boundary and processor-like artifacts speed creativity consistently with operations.
messages.changelog.2.3.9.title: Creativity artifact scaling
